import HartshorneLib.Chapter4DivisorMultiplication
import Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Linear.FunctorCategory

/-!
# Products of divisor sections

Multiplication of rational functions gives a bilinear product of divisor
sections on every open, compatible with restriction. A global section of
`O(E)` therefore gives a morphism `O(D) -> O(D + E)`, linearly in that section.
This is the coefficient morphism for the degree-zero cohomology product.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Opposite TopologicalSpace AlgebraicGeometry

namespace Hartshorne

noncomputable section

attribute [local instance] functionFieldOverModule Scheme.overModule

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
variable {X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))} [IsIntegral X.left]
  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom] [IsProper X.hom]

/-- Products satisfy the sum-divisor bound, including on the empty open. -/
theorem mul_mem_divisorSections {D E : CurveDivisor k X} {U : X.left.Opens}
    {s t : X.left.functionField} (hs : s ∈ divisorSections D U)
    (ht : t ∈ divisorSections E U) : s * t ∈ divisorSections (D + E) U := by
  by_cases hU : (U : Set X.left).Nonempty
  · rw [mem_divisorSections_of_nonempty hU] at hs ht ⊢
    intro x hx hxU
    rw [map_mul, divisorBound_add]
    exact mul_le_mul' (hs x hx hxU) (ht x hx hxU)
  · rw [divisorSections_of_empty hU, Submodule.mem_bot] at hs ⊢
    simp only [hs, zero_mul]

/-- The bilinear product of local divisor sections. -/
def divisorSectionsMul (D E : CurveDivisor k X) (U : X.left.Opens) :
    divisorSections D U →ₗ[k] divisorSections E U →ₗ[k]
      divisorSections (D + E) U :=
  LinearMap.mk₂ k
    (fun s t => ⟨s.val * t.val, mul_mem_divisorSections s.property t.property⟩)
    (fun s s' t => Subtype.ext (add_mul _ _ _))
    (fun r s t => Subtype.ext (by
      simp only [SetLike.val_smul, functionFieldOverModule_smul_def, mul_assoc]))
    (fun s t t' => Subtype.ext (mul_add _ _ _))
    (fun r s t => Subtype.ext (by
      simp only [SetLike.val_smul, functionFieldOverModule_smul_def, mul_left_comm]))

@[simp]
lemma divisorSectionsMul_coe (D E : CurveDivisor k X) (U : X.left.Opens)
    (s : divisorSections D U) (t : divisorSections E U) :
    (divisorSectionsMul D E U s t : X.left.functionField) =
      (s : X.left.functionField) * (t : X.left.functionField) := rfl

/-- The local product commutes with restriction, also to an empty open. -/
lemma divisorSectionsMul_res (D E : CurveDivisor k X)
    {U V : X.left.Opens} (h : V ≤ U)
    (s : divisorSections D U) (t : divisorSections E U) :
    divisorSectionsRes (D + E) h (divisorSectionsMul D E U s t) =
      divisorSectionsMul D E V (divisorSectionsRes D h s)
        (divisorSectionsRes E h t) := by
  by_cases hV : (V : Set X.left).Nonempty
  · apply Subtype.ext
    simp only [divisorSectionsRes_coe h hV, divisorSectionsMul_coe]
  · letI := divisorSections_subsingleton_of_empty (D := D + E) hV
    exact Subsingleton.elim _ _

/-- Multiplication by a global section as a morphism of divisor sheaves. -/
def divisorSheafMulSection (D E : CurveDivisor k X)
    (s : divisorSections E ⊤) : divisorSheaf D ⟶ divisorSheaf (D + E) where
  hom :=
    { app := fun U => ModuleCat.ofHom
        ((divisorSectionsMul D E U.unop).flip (divisorSectionsRes E le_top s))
      naturality := fun {U V} i => by
        apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
        apply LinearMap.ext
        intro t
        change divisorSectionsMul D E V.unop
            (divisorSectionsRes D (leOfHom i.unop) t)
            (divisorSectionsRes E le_top s) =
          divisorSectionsRes (D + E) (leOfHom i.unop)
            (divisorSectionsMul D E U.unop t (divisorSectionsRes E le_top s))
        rw [divisorSectionsMul_res]
        congr 1
        exact DFunLike.congr_fun
          (divisorSectionsRes_comp (D := E) (leOfHom i.unop) le_top) s }

@[simp]
lemma divisorSheafMulSection_app (D E : CurveDivisor k X)
    (s : divisorSections E ⊤) (U : X.left.Opens) (t : divisorSections D U) :
    (divisorSheafMulSection D E s).hom.app (op U) t =
      divisorSectionsMul D E U t (divisorSectionsRes E le_top s) := rfl

/-- On a nonempty open the sheaf morphism multiplies rational-function values. -/
lemma divisorSheafMulSection_app_coe (D E : CurveDivisor k X)
    (s : divisorSections E ⊤) (U : X.left.Opens)
    (hU : (U : Set X.left).Nonempty) (t : divisorSections D U) :
    Subtype.val (show divisorSections (D + E) U from
      (divisorSheafMulSection D E s).hom.app (op U) t) =
      (t : X.left.functionField) * (s : X.left.functionField) := by
  rw [divisorSheafMulSection_app, divisorSectionsMul_coe,
    divisorSectionsRes_coe le_top hU]

/-- Global sections act linearly by coefficient-sheaf morphisms. -/
def divisorSheafMulSectionLinear (D E : CurveDivisor k X) :
    divisorSections E ⊤ →ₗ[k] (divisorSheaf D ⟶ divisorSheaf (D + E)) where
  toFun := divisorSheafMulSection D E
  map_add' s t := by
    ext U a
    change divisorSectionsMul D E U.unop a (divisorSectionsRes E le_top (s + t)) =
      divisorSectionsMul D E U.unop a (divisorSectionsRes E le_top s) +
        divisorSectionsMul D E U.unop a (divisorSectionsRes E le_top t)
    rw [map_add, map_add]
  map_smul' r s := by
    ext U a
    change divisorSectionsMul D E U.unop a (divisorSectionsRes E le_top (r • s)) =
      r • divisorSectionsMul D E U.unop a (divisorSectionsRes E le_top s)
    rw [map_smul, map_smul]

@[simp]
lemma divisorSheafMulSectionLinear_apply (D E : CurveDivisor k X)
    (s : divisorSections E ⊤) :
    divisorSheafMulSectionLinear D E s = divisorSheafMulSection D E s := rfl

end
end Hartshorne
